mods.name: Soul
mods.description: Client-side Hypixel SkyBlock features. Fresh 26.2 baseline.

releases.notes:
## New
- **Experimentation Table**: all three games in Soul's window, with solvers, misclick blocking and a rare card warning
- **Search everywhere**: one search over your island chests and storage pages, from anywhere on SkyBlock
- **Search everywhere**: a Forge tab (`Ctrl+Tab`) plans a forge recipe down to what you already own
- **Storage overlay**: your Ender Chest and backpacks on one searchable wall; click a page to open it
- **Override Skyblocker storage** is on by default while the overlay is enabled; turn it off to keep Skyblocker's
- **Commissions HUD**: shows your commissions with their progress on screen, DONE in green
- **Highlight completed commissions**: finished commissions get a green mark in the Commissions menu
- **Hide Powder Coating particles**: hides the dust around players wearing coated Divan armor

## Improved
- **Island chests**: blue slot highlights mark matching stacks; shared co-op chests sync anywhere on SkyBlock
- **Log mineshaft visits**: `/soul mineshaft` and the Profile Viewer now show your odds per profile

## Fixed
- **Storage overlay** keeps clear of the screen edge and recipe viewer panels, so they no longer cover it
- Tracker panels now draw under recipe viewer item lists in your inventory instead of over them

releases.notes:
## New
- **Terminal solver**: all six F7/M7 terminals show what to click in a Soul window or the normal menu
- **Device solvers**: highlights for Simon Says, Lights, Arrow Align and Sharpshooter in F7/M7
- **Terminal solver** and **Device solvers** can block wrong clicks; Sharpshooter only highlights
- **Leap menu**: four teammate tiles with class corners, locations and number keys 1-4
- **Leap menu**: hover a teammate to mark them on the undimmed **Dungeon map**
- **Archer roles**: objective markers and advice on who to leap to through F7/M7 boss fights
- **Island chests**: search remembered items and book enchantments, then locate matching chests
- **Island chests**: co-op sharing starts on when enabled; existing sharing choices stay unchanged
- **Island chests**: press `K` to search or return from locating, and `Esc` to cancel; the key is editable
- **Boss timers**: pad tick, crush window, Storm's phases and Goldor's death tick at your crosshair
- **Boss timers**: countdown until Goldor's terminals open
- **Dragon spawn countdown**: M7 dragon timers at their spawns and above your crosshair
- **Section not open warning**: warns while you stand in a Goldor section that has not begun
- **Hide Soulweaver skulls**: hide Haunted Skulls around you and your party in dungeons
- **Hide fire**: separately hide flames on your screen and on burning players and mobs

## Improved
- **Dungeon map**: default class colors match the **Leap menu**; your custom colors stay unchanged
- **Updates**: the update window opens before the main menu; update notices appear as you join
- **Start**: What's new stays listed for the whole version; seen lines lose only their NEW highlight
- Safer login to Soul services; dungeon secret sharing is private to your run's teammates

## Fixed
- **Pet HUD** follows your active pet when you switch loadouts
- **Dungeon map**: teammate markers no longer sit about two blocks north-west of their real position
- **Updates**: automatic restart prompts wait for 60 idle seconds, never in Dungeons or Kuudra

### Release - Minecraft 1.21.11

#### Highlights

- Dragon Profit HUD with bazaar / lowest-BIN pricing, kill-source attribution (summoned vs lootshare), and eye-cost-adjusted per-kill profit.
- Dragon-down chat announcements — Legion stats and dragon profit summary, with party-chat / local-only routing and 500 ms delay so they don't break Hypixel's DRAGON DOWN block.
- Right-click in chat to copy a message — Shift for the single visible line, Ctrl to preserve §-color codes.
- [Soul] prefix on outgoing party-chat announcements (toggle in General → Chat, default on).

#### Fixes & improvements

- Dragon Profit HUD: split header (Dragons / LS counts + Eyes Placed with cost), per-dragon average chip, Profit hover tooltip with gross / eye-cost breakdown.
- Recovered Summoning Eyes now decrement the pending count for accurate eye-cost math.
- Travel Scroll to Dragon's Nest catalog entry corrected.
- "Old Dragon profit" wording in chat announcement (was "Old profit").
- Crash fix when switching the Source filter to Lootshare.
- Multi-line hover tooltips supported on Soul HUDs.

Release - Minecraft 1.21.11

  Highlights

  - 3×3 anchor grid in /soul gui.
  - Per-HUD style overrides.
  - Use Minecraft Font.
  - Welcome landing page.
  - About → Used Software.
  - Fishing tracker UX upgrades.

  Fixes & improvements

  - Bobbin Time / Legion boost formula fixed (additive stacking across armor pieces).
  - Text shadow rewrite with configurable size slider.
  - Bold font default; Inter Bold + Black bundled.
  - GUI-Scale-independent screens.
  - /soul gui help dialog + Reset HUD shortcut.
  - Default global scale bumped 1.5 → 1.65.
  - Use Minecraft Font respects scrollable list bounds.
  - Fishing tracker counter rollup (DH/Cocoons into Catches).

  One-time HUD layout reset

  gui_layout.json is wiped on first launch of 3.1.0 — the new 9-point anchor system stores enum fields old files don't have. Custom HUD
  positions will need to be set again via /soul gui.
